blocks.text: Pesticides aise chemicals hain jo keeron (insects), jari-bootiyon (weeds) ya phaphoond (fungi) jaise nuqsan deh jaandaron (pests) ko maarne ya qaboo karne ke liye use hote hain. Pesticides fasalon ko nuqsan se bachate hain, khuraak zaya hone se rokte hain aur khuraak ki mustaqil farahmi yaqeeni banate hain. Jis pest ko yeh nishana banate hain, us ke lihaz se inhein teen qismon mein baanta jata hai: insecticides (keeron ke liye), herbicides (jari-bootiyon ke liye) aur fungicides (phaphoond ke liye).

Insecticides woh chemicals hain jo keeron ke nervous system (asaab ke nizam) ko nishana bana kar unhein qaboo karte hain. Organophosphates ya neonicotinoids jaise kai jadeed insecticides neurotoxins (nervous system ke liye zehr) ka kaam karte hain; yeh keeron ka nervous system kharab kar dete hain, jis se keere ko falij (paralysis) ho jata hai aur woh mar jata hai. Neonicotinoids ka talluq shehed ki makhiyon (honeybees) mein “Colony Collapse Disorder” (makhiyon ke chhatte ka achanak khatam ho jana) se bataya gaya hai, jo duniya bhar mein pollination (phoolon ka zar-pashi ka amal) ke liye khatra hai.

Herbicides woh chemicals hain jo na-pasandeeda paudon ko qaboo karte hain jo fasal se muqabla karte hain; inhein weeds (jari-bootiyan) kehte hain. Kuch herbicides enzyme ko kaam se rok dete hain (enzyme inhibition) aur zaroori amino acids banne nahi dete. Jab ke kuch herbicides electron transport ko bigaar kar weeds ko photosynthesis karne se rok dete hain.

Fungicides phaphoond ke cells ki salamati (cellular integrity) ko nishana bana kar use maarte hain. Yeh phaphoond ki cell membrane (cell ki jhilli) mein ergosterol banne ko rokte hain; mazboot membrane ke baghair phaphoond ka cell risne lagta hai aur mar jata hai. Sab se aam misalein triazoles aur strobilurins hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab zinc phosphide ko aam fungicides mein ginti hai, lekin zinc phosphide chuhe maarne ki dawa (rodenticide) hai, fungicide nahi. Neez sirf kuch fungicides (jaise triazoles) ergosterol banne ko rokte hain; strobilurins phaphoond ke cells mein energy banne ka amal rokte hain.

Jadeed khuraak ke programs mein pesticides bohat ahem kirdar ada kar rahe hain. Yeh paudon ko pests aur bimariyon se bachate hain aur fasalon ki paidawar barhate hain. Yeh wabaon (epidemics) ka khatra kam karte hain aur insaani sehat bhi behtar karte hain. Yeh duniya bhar mein food security (sab ke liye kaafi khuraak) aur istehkaam mein bhi hissa dalte hain.

Pesticides sehat ko nuqsan bhi de sakte hain, kyunke kuch carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wale) aur neurotoxic hain. Faidemand keere, parinde aur paani ke jaandaar bhi pesticides se mutasir ho sakte hain. Kheton se beh kar aane wala paani (runoff) paani ke zakheeron ko ganda kar sakta hai aur aabi jaandaron ko nuqsan deta hai. Pesticides un jaandaron ko bhi nuqsan de sakte hain jo un ka nishana nahi, jaise pollinators (maslan shehed ki makhiyan), jo bohat si fasalon ki pollination mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain. Waqt ke saath pests kuch pesticides ke khilaf immunity (mazahmat) paida kar lete hain, aur woh pesticides kam asar karte hain. Phir humein zyada zehreele pesticides use karne parte hain, jo mahol aur sehat ke liye mazeed masail paida kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Pesticides ke istemal ka aik faida aur aik khatra batayein.
blocks.explanation: Faida: fasalon ko bachate aur paidawar barhate hain (food security). Khatra: maslan shehed ki makhiyon jaise ghair-nishana jaandaron ko nuqsan, paani ki gandagi, ya pests mein mazahmat.

items: Insecticides nervous system, herbicides amino acids ya photosynthesis, fungicides cell membrane (ergosterol) par asar karte hain.
Nuqsan: cancer aur nervous system ka khatra, makhiyan, paani ki gandagi, pests ki mazahmat.
